target_customer: IVF couples who pay for polygenic and reproductive genetic screening, and earlier pharma teams for interpretable protein AI
problem: IVF patients choosing among embryos have limited genetic information. Reticular offers polygenic prediction and reproductive gene screening, with a longer-term aim of using biological models to find cures for heritable disease.
business_model: direct-to-consumer genetic test and embryo report sales (about 399 to 749 USD per panel per its site)

founders.name: John Yang
education: MIT, AI and Mathematics, class of 2024
founders.background_notes: Published ML and bio research in NeurIPS and Nature per YC page.

founders.name: Nithin Parsan
education: MIT (roommate of John Yang for four years, per YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: Named as founder in the YC launch post; degree and employers not listed.

competitors.name: Orchid
competitors.what: Whole genome sequencing of IVF embryos for monogenic and polygenic risk
competitors.traction_then: launched embryo test Dec 2023, priced about 2,500 USD per embryo per CNBC coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: Polygenic prediction needs genomic data access, validated models and lab and clinical partnerships; the founders cite ML and biology research. A 2023 Nature study found embryo polygenic scores not sufficiently robust, which shows the science is hard.

defensibility.rationale: Several startups (Orchid, Nucleus, Herasight) compete. Defensibility would rest on data and trust, which a two-person team had not built at founding.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or incumbent copying found in sources.

market_need_then: IVF patients and clinics were adopting embryo screening, and Orchid launched whole genome embryo reports in December 2023. Public criticism (NPR and others) shows contested demand and ethics.

branding.domain_note: Uses reticular.com exact match per the YC listing; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Reassuring and conversational with prominent disclaimers; tagline From the Lab. For the Parents.

branding.brand_signature: Tagline From the Lab. For the Parents.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself found; embryo selection coverage centers on rivals.

pivots.from: Steerable interpretable AI for protein engineering and pharma (YC launch post)
pivots.to: Polygenic prediction for embryo selection, then at-home reproductive genetic screening
pivots.why: Not stated; the date is unknown and the order is inferred from differing YC descriptions.

outcome_analysis: Reticular is a two-person company from Fall 2024 that appears to have moved from interpretable protein AI to embryo polygenic prediction and now sells an at-home reproductive gene panel. No priced round beyond the standard YC deal is verifiable. Outcome is unknown at this point, with ethical and scientific controversy around embryo selection a risk.
notes: No funding announcement found. VCBacked lists about 500K pre-seed (Dec 2024) from YC, aggregator only, unverified so not recorded as a round. Searches for acquisition or shutdown found nothing for this company. Pivot order is uncertain. Competition: only one dated source found. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed dated December 2024 is recorded and rests on VCBacked alone. A cross-check search found no press announcement.
